messages:
maria_pm: AcmeHealth asked for a tight MVP: adaptive batching + prescriptive cache + quant fallback. pilot target ~6w. can we do it?
aj_eng: batching + cache yes with work. quant fallback full automation probably not in 6w.
sarah_cs: customer will accept manual rollback for quant if we provide clear steps. batching+cache are must haves.
leo_ml: propose eval alert rule to protect quality: name=concordance-drop; trigger if delta <= -5% over 500 samples; action notify + rollback.
emily_se: docs ask: provide mobile vs server presets and an SDK toggle. I can draft examples.
tom_product: rollout plan: canary 5% (24h) -> 25% (72h) -> full. auto-fallback on eval alert.
aj_eng: SLO gate: if batching causes >10% p95 regression on a route, disable batching for that route.
sarah_cs: legal: cache only on non-PII routes; need route opt-out snippet in pilot doc.
maria_pm: acceptance bullets to share with Acme: 3 customers, batching <=10% p95 regression, cost savings >=15% for batched traffic, cache hit-rate >=20% in 2w, quant documented + eval alerts.
leo_ml: quick eng test plan: baseline -> enable presets -> synthetic load -> eval set -> enable cache -> test quant swap (int8) -> verify quality or rollback.
aj_eng: rough estimate: batching+cache core 4w eng +1w test/docs; quant fallback + eval hooks 2-3w. target 6-8w if parallelized.
maria_pm: actions: @aj_eng create epic+estimates (EOD Fri); @leo_ml publish eval templates (Tue); @emily_se draft 1-pager+SDK (Wed); @sarah_cs confirm legal & pilots (Thu); @tom_product finalize rollout text (Fri).
release-bot: note: optimize-toolkit/pilot-config v0.1 scheduled to staging 2025-02-12T09:00:00Z
maria_pm: thanks. leaning to greenlight MVP minus auto-quant. sync Wed 10am for sign-off.
